mirrorV5.intro: Each project has a Markdown folder. Edits to prose and fields in another editor merge into Drifting after you save.
mirrorV5.offWarning: Drifting merges pending edits before turning the folder off. Existing files stay where they are. You can turn it back on in Local Data.
mirrorV5.identity: The drifting-id does not match this entry and prose module.
mirrorV5.lineage: The entry or prose has been restored, reshaped, or deleted. The file’s edits could not be merged.
mirrorV5.owned: Another Drifting installation owns this folder.
mirrorV5.unsafePath: Drifting could not safely access this path in the project folder.
mirrorV5.occupied: A file already occupies this path.
mirrorV5.duplicate: Two files have the same drifting-id.
mirrorV5.moved: Renaming and moving files do not sync in this version.
mirrorV5.readOnly: The read-only properties were restored from the project.
mirrorV5.malformedTable: The table could not be read. The original table is still in Drifting.
mirrorV5.unknownImage: The image points outside the project’s file library. The line was imported as text.
mirrorV5.fieldConflict: This field was also edited in Drifting. Both versions were kept.

bookTransfer.legacy: This file was exported by Drifting 0.1. Import it there, then hand that library over to this version.
bookTransfer.older: This book file is in an earlier format that this version no longer reads.

trash.bodyWithoutBook: This project ({{entries}}) leaves All projects. You can restore it from Recently Deleted for 30 days; after that it is permanently deleted.
trash.bodyWithoutChapters: This project ({{words}} words · {{elements}} elements) leaves All projects. You can restore it from Recently Deleted for 30 days; after that it is permanently deleted.

errors.legacy: This is a Drifting 0.1 backup, which this version cannot restore directly. Restore it in Drifting 0.1, then import that library with “Import · Drifting 0.1” on the bookshelf.

update.install_failed: Drifting {{version}} couldn't be installed when you last quit. This version is unchanged; it tries again next time you quit.
update.install_failed_admin: Drifting {{version}} couldn't be installed when you last quit: the folder Drifting is in can't be written to. This version is unchanged.
update.interrupted: The update didn't finish downloading and was discarded. It downloads again at the next check.
update.local_error: The update couldn't be saved on this computer and was stopped. This version keeps working.
update.older_offered: You're up to date. The update service offers {{version}}, which is older than this version, so it won't be installed.
update.ready_on_quit: Drifting {{version}} is downloaded and its signature verified. It installs when you quit.
update.refused_app: The downloaded update isn't Drifting and was discarded. This version keeps working.
update.refused_signature: The downloaded update failed signature verification and was discarded. This version keeps working.
update.refused_version: The downloaded update isn't the version it claims to be, possibly an older one, and was refused. This version keeps working.
update.server_error: The update service has a problem right now. Try again later; this version keeps working.
